Corollary
[Curvature bound from a scalar-curvature bound under pinching] ↗ thm:pinching-persists-from-time-a

Under the hypotheses of the preceding theorem there is a continuous $\phi $ such that $R(x,t)\le R_0$ implies $|\Rm (x,t)|\le \phi (R_0)$.
Proof

↗ thm:pinching-persists-from-time-a \sketch If $X=0$, $|\Rm |\le R/2$; if $X>0$, pinching bounds $X$ by $R_0$ for large $R_0$, and hence bounds $\lambda $ and $\nu $, which bounds $|\Rm |$.

□
